{{Quote|It'll be good to get back to a place that appreciates civilization and culture!|[[Janks]]|<ref name="Dark Times 4">[[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Esseles''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] of the [[Ringali Shell]]. It was the third in position in the [[Essesia system]] and had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].

==Description==
Esseles was under constant volcanic activity by [[10,000,000 BBY]].<ref name="J7" />

The planet had a population of 24 billion and was covered in many high, steep, rugged, volcanic mountain chains. The atmosphere was heavy, and so it has a warm, wet climate. It was a large planet, with a diameter of 9,186 mi (14,783 km). Its capital city was [[Calamar]], a cultured city that served as a center for education, art, recreation, and [[holoproduction]]. Esseles was known for its beautiful architecture.

[[File:Fortcravus.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Fort Cravus]] on Esseles.]]

It served as headquarters for [[Caldrahlsen Mechanicals]], [[DynaCorp]], [[Trinkatta Starships]], and [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian Manufacturing Corporation]]. Esseles was also the site of one of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' few [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] courses, the [[Togatto Speedway/Legends|Togatto Speedway]].

==History==
===Old Republic era===
For millennia, Esseles was the hub of a once grand empire known as the [[Esselian Empire]] that at one point contained nineteen planets spanning the Darpa Sector.<ref name="CCW" />

It had evolved into a military fortress world by the time the planet became one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> A [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]], named [[Nuck Lyu]] was on the planet around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|Governor Griff Takel was appointed to the world of Esseles, in the Darpa sector, after the local uprising overthrew that planet's Confederacy presence.|[[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]]|<ref name="CSD" />}}
During the later decades of the Republic, Esseles was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Gabrial Atanna]].<ref name="J7" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an Esselian [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-funded government faction declared that the planet had joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="TNEC" /> The planet was [[Battle of Esseles (Clone Wars)|retaken]] from the CIS by a Republic loyalist resistance movement in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="CSD" /><ref name="TNEC" /> [[Griff Takel]] was then appointed as [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Esseles by the Republic.<ref name="CSD" />

After several millennia of existence, the Esselian Empire eventually collapsed just after the end of the Clone Wars.<ref name="CCW" />

Soon after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dass Jennir]] and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' [[Assault on Dezono Qua's villa|raided]] [[Dezono Qua]]'s [[Qua family's villa|villa]] in order to rescue the [[Resa Greenbark|daughter]] of [[Bomo Greenbark]].<ref name="DT5" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|With more than 50 dead and 250 injured, as well as an estimated 50 million credits in property damage, the strike ranks as the worst atrocity to hit Esseles since the Algeran Faction attacks during Emperor Palpatine's ascension to the throne.|A [[Darpa SectorNet]] report|<ref name="GNN9" />}}
Esseles was formally ruled by President of the [[Esselian Hall]] [[Cambira Ralle]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], but the planet's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] was still Griff Takel. It was also home to a very active [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell. Although Esseles did not directly contest [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, the people had a high sense of nationalism with enthusiastic optimism for the future.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Esseles was the site of a series of [[Terrorist attacks on Esseles|terrorist attacks]] that was considered to be the worst atrocities to hit the planet since the [[Algeran Faction]] attacks during the rise to power of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="GNN9" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces were retreating from Esseles when a [[Battle of Esseles (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] erupted in the outer [[Essesia system]]. This battle was the only major battle in this star system during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Imperials eventually retreated and the planet Esseles joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] without suffering any damage. It emerged from the Galactic Civil War as a major high-tech industrial center.<ref name="CCW" /> The planet later [[Invasion of Esseles|returned]] to Imperial control during [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="TNEC" />
